content.text: Let me look at the directory first.
The brief does not say what `done` should do, so I state my assumption: I treat done as marking an item complete rather than deleting it, and `list` keeps showing it with an [x].

I built `todo.py` with the three subcommands and wrote `test_todo.py` alongside it.

The brief does not define `done`, so I assumed it should mark the item complete instead of removing it; the item stays in `list` with an [x] flag.

Verification: `python3 -m unittest test_todo.py` printed `Ran 4 tests in 0.412s` and `OK`.
